title: Brown Butter Chocolate Chip Cookies 🍪  These are soft, chewy, and all...
description: Brown Butter Chocolate Chip Cookies 🍪  These are soft, chewy, and all-around my idea of perfect cookies!  (recipe makes ~14 cookies)  Ingredients: ¾ cup (170g) unsalted butter, browned (should be 140g after browning) 2 tsp water or milk  ¾ cup (165g) brown sugar, packed ¼ cup (50g) granulated sugar 1 egg + 1 egg yolk, room temp 2 tsp vanilla extract 1¾ cups (220g) all-purpose flour, spooned & leveled or weighed (don’t pack it in!) ¾ tsp baking soda ½ tsp salt ½ tsp cornstarch 1 cup (170g) chocolate chips/chopped chocolate (I like to do half semi-sweet and half milk)  + more chocolate chips/chopped chocolate for topping Ingredients:  In a saucepan, brown the butter over medium heat. Stir constantly until it foams then turns a golden brown color. It should have a nutty aroma with little brown bits. Transfer to a heat safe bowl (make sure to get all those little brown bits in there!) Cool for 10 minutes then mix in 2 tsp of water. Let this cool to a softened texture/more opaque. (I like to place it in the fridge & stir periodically to speed this up)  Gently cream the soft brown butter and both sugars together until just combined.  Mix in the egg, egg yolk, and vanilla until smooth. In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, baking soda, cornstarch, and salt. Gently fold the dry ingredients into the wet ingredients until just combined. Fold in the chocolate chips. Do not over mix. Chill the dough for 30-60 minutes. Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Scoop ~2 tbsp of dough per cookie placing them on a parchment lined baking sheet with ample space between each other.  Bake for about 10-12 minutes until the edges are set & lightly golden. The middles should still be a little soft. Cool before transferring to a wire rack or plate.  Enjoy!  #bakingrecipe #chocolatechip #brownbutter #cookies #recipe
